'''TX-567''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{RPG}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], TX-567 was among a group of Imperials in the [[sub-facility]] task force located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tol Ado]]. Working under an Imperial [[Major/Legends|major]], he assisted the major in interrogating [[Santo (Twi'lek)|Santo]], an Imperial informant on the rebel elements located in the sub-facility. When Luke Skywalker, disguised as an Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] attempted to commandeer TX-567's [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], the trooper refused his request, due to the needs of the sub-facility task force having precedence over mainline troops.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
TX-567 was created by [[Troy Denning]] and appeared in one of the [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] strands of the [[1990]] [[West End Games]] role-playing supplement ''[[Jedi's Honor]]''. The fate of TX-567 is up to the reader, who can choose to force TX-567 to turn the repulsorcraft
over to Skywalker. If this occurs, TX-567 and the Imperial major are killed by Skywalker with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and then hidden in an access panel to keep from arousing suspicion. If Skywalker listens to TX-567 and decides not to commandeer his vehicle, the stormtrooper and his comrades continue their duty and are not encountered again.
